body:
The phone navigation bar was uneven: a bottom safe area padded it from inside, More used another type and a hairline icon, and labels had no inline room. Fixed in 37f9aa5; the existing HTTPS app was rebuilt and restarted with unchanged identity, users and sessions.

Verified in Chromium and WebKit on synthetic hosts, including an emulated home-indicator inset in Chromium. No physical iPhone was used. Evidence: progress/2026-10-06-phone-dock-alignment.md.
